verification mission stays in flown, case stays in verifying, and CloudWatch alarms report unclosed fumigations." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="75" width="850" x="2480" y="3010" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_s3_legend" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="3520" x="40" y="3150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_s3_legend_text" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontColor=#1e293b;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacing=10;" value="<b>Amazon S3 Drone Object Bucket Hierarchy (Workload Account pdn | us-east-1 | SSE-KMS Key 'objects' | Block Public Access | 5-Year Lifecycle Retention ASM-145):</b><br/>• <b>Pest Case Missions:</b> <code>farms/{farm_id}/cases/{case_id}/{mission_type}/{mission_id}/</code> (types: <code>confirmation</code>, <code>fumigation</code>, <code>verification</code>)<br/>• <b>Mission Sub-Prefixes:</b> <code>package/mission-package-v{n}.json</code> (issued package) | <code>record/flight-record.json</code> (returned record) | <code>photos/{seq}.jpg</code> | <code>track/{seq}.json</code> | <code>maps/</code> | <code>polygons/</code><br/>• <b>Review Campaign Missions:</b> <code>farms/{farm_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/{mission_type}/{mission_id}/</code> (types: <code>delimitation</code>, <code>estimation</code>) | <b>Extra Delimitation:</b> <code>farms/{farm_id}/extra/{mission_id}/delimitation/</code><br/>• <b>Quarantine Prefix:</b> <code>quarantine/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{original_key}</code> (unmatched grants, revoked pilot/kit, or person screen quarantine; never linked to order or inference, PD-104)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="3500" x="50" y="3160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

STORE-AND-FORWARD INVARIANT (Point 3 / A10 sec 6 / ASM-146):
Order in flown does NOT expire at window_end while buffered without signal (PD-141).
Any persisted fumigation flight record moves order to executed, even if closure is aborted;
flags are recorded, and verification determines whether the case can close.

35. Case closure triggers plot state switch: Plot returns from Precision Mode back to Area Mode (ADR-002).
Traceability complete: sack harvest & review campaigns continue in Area Mode.

div.div:
CLOSURE INVARIANT (Point 2 / A15 sec 5.1 / ASM-141 / PD-141):
'Si ese archivo no llega, la fumigación sigue abierta.' If the verification object or track does not arrive,
verification mission stays in flown, case stays in verifying, and CloudWatch alarms report unclosed fumigations.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 3195px; margin-left: 39px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1e293b;

div.div:
Amazon S3 Drone Object Bucket Hierarchy (Workload Account pdn | us-east-1 | SSE-KMS Key 'objects' | Block Public Access | 5-Year Lifecycle Retention ASM-145):
• Pest Case Missions: farms/{farm_id}/cases/{case_id}/{mission_type}/{mission_id}/ (types: confirmation, fumigation, verification)
• Mission Sub-Prefixes: package/mission-package-v{n}.json (issued package) | record/flight-record.json (returned record) | photos/{seq}.jpg | track/{seq}.json | maps/ | polygons/
• Review Campaign Missions: farms/{farm_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/{mission_type}/{mission_id}/ (types: delimitation, estimation) | Extra Delimitation: farms/{farm_id}/extra/{mission_id}/delimitation/
• Quarantine Prefix: quarantine/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{original_key} (unmatched grants, revoked pilot/kit, or person screen quarantine; never linked to order or inference, PD-104)
